name: Smart Home
source: Smart Home Panel V3.1.0 native subclass over validated Smart Home Panel V2.0.5 + Suite Runtime V1.1.0 + Card Layout V1.0.0; V2 remains packaged as fallback
bridge_source: Smart Home Native V3 Bridge V1.0.0 imports and preserves Native Dashboard Bridge V1.3.0 shell/header/menu behavior
base_frontend_source: bundled exact Smart Home Panel V2.0.5
frontend_source: smart-home-panel-v3.js V3.1.0; inherits validated V2.0.5 functionality through smart-home-panel-runtime.js V1.1.0 and smart-home-card-layout.js V1.0.0
runtime_guard_source: Suite runtime prevents redundant narrow rerenders while editor/dialogs are open
card_layout_runtime_source: Preserves extra value/bar/history widgets, actions and flat order compatibility

layout_v3_source: Native SmartHomePanelV3 class owns sections, semantic sizes, responsive layout and editor integration without patching the V2 prototype
